text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
Hey~
Are you doing okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっほー
元気してる？

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
Looks like neither Fio nor Homare are around?
You got lost, didn't you?
Kya haha♪ In this state, it's no wonder even familiar streets are confusing♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
フィオもホマレもいないみたいね？
あんた迷子になっちゃったんでしょ。
きゃはは♪　
慣れた街も
この有様じゃ無理もないか♪

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I've been caught♪
I'm going to be handed over to a scary big sister～♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらら
捕まっちゃった♪
こわ～いお姉ちゃんに突き出されちゃう～♪

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
But grabbing a girl in a swimsuit with both hands,
that's quite the behavior, right?
You're suspicious creep～
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
水着の女の子を両手でわしづかみにするなんて、
随分な扱いよね？
立派なへんたいふしんしゃさん
だわ～

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
Escape success♪
That was too easy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほい
脱出成功♪
チョロすぎるわよ。

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, you can't swim anyway, right?
We've taken safety measures in the water,
but make sure to watch your step as you walk.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それよりあんた、
どうせ泳げないんでしょ？
水に安全策は施してあるけど、
ちゃんと足元を確認しながら歩きなさいよ。

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
You've been wandering around looking for me here and there.
It's so dangerous.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私を捜しながらあっちこっちフラフラしちゃってさ。
危なっかしいったらないわ。

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
That's not true.
I just came to tease the silly you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ～？
そんなわけないでしょ。
お間抜けなあんたをからかいにきただけよ。

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
…Well, if something happened to you,
Fio would be sad too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……まぁ、
あんたに何かあったら、
フィオのやつが悲しむってのもあるけど。

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what Fio sees in someone like you?
I don't get it at all.
Maybe if I look more closely, I'll understand?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ったく、
あんたみたいなやつのどこがいいんだかね～？
私にはさっぱりだわ。
もっとじっくり見れば分かるのかしらね？

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text: Let me see your face better.
text_block_list.orig_text: ちょっと顔よく見せてみなさいよ。

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, hmph, I see.
Is that so?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふんふん、
ほーう。
なるほどね～？

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text: Forehead that's easy to doodle on.
text_block_list.orig_text: 落書きしやすそうなおでこ。

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text: Cheeks with average elasticity.
text_block_list.orig_text: ほっぺの弾力はまぁまぁ。

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text: Eyes are...pure.
text_block_list.orig_text:
目は……
ピュアッピュアね。

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't turn your face away.
I'm looking at you right now.
Or what? Are you embarrassed?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こら、
顔を背けるんじゃないの。
いま私が見てるんだから。
それとも何？　
照れちゃった？

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to get embarrassed now.
We've already shared a bond this close. Ah, do you even remember? When you made me covered in drool.
text_block_list.orig_text:
別に今更照れる必要なんてないでしょうに。
口にまで入れた仲じゃない。
あ、
あんたこれ覚えてるんだっけ？
私をヨダレまみれにしてくれたこと。

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
With this mouth, you did it! This this♪
Your lips are all soft and squishy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このお口でね！　
このこのっ♪
ぷにぷにの唇しちゃってさ！

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text: Woah!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うひゃ
あっ！？

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
What the heck did you do?!
Soaking me all over again because of you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんてことしてくれんのよも～～～！
またあんたのせいでビショビショよ！

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Because I was tickling?
Blaming others, how brave of you～?
text_block_list.orig_text:
は？　
私がくすぐるから？
人のせいにするとはいい度胸ね～？

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, anyway, I better go wash myself.
It seems I'm destined to get dirty because of you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～あ、
とりあえず体洗ってこよ。
つくづくあんたに汚される運命なのね、
私は。

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
Only I end up like this~
Though I don't need such a special feeling.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私だけよね～
こんな目に遭うの。
いやそんな特別感はいらないけどさ。

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'm leaving.
Seems like Fio and Homare are nearby.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあもう行くわ。
フィオとホマレが近くに来てるっぽいし。

text_block_list.name: Navi
text_block_list.text:
Catch up with me again after regrouping♪
Bye bye♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
合流して改めて私を追ってきなさい♪
バッイバ～イ♪
